name: Neusa Borges
bio: Neusa Borges (Born August 3, 1941) is a legendary Brazilian actress, whose career in film and television spans for over 40 years.

credits.title: God Is Still Brazilian
credits.overview: God needs to return to Earth when celestial beings rebel against humanity and decide to launch another meteor to exterminate life on the planet.

credits.title: Falas Negras: Histórias (Im)possíveis
credits.overview: Janaína is a black screenwriter embarking on a new audiovisual project. She meets the rest of the team, where all of whom are white, on a farm. Pedro, the leader of the script room, disappears. Janaína investigates and makes unimaginable discoveries.

credits.title: Mussum, o Filmis
credits.overview: The trajectory of Antônio Carlos Bernardes Gomes, known as Mussum, from Trapalhões. His poor childhood, his military career, his relationship with Mangueira and his success with the group Originais do Samba, as well as behind the scenes as a member of Trapalhões.

credits.title: A Cut Above
credits.overview: With his mom's salon on the brink of bankruptcy, a dedicated son rolls up his sleeves to help and discovers himself as the coolest barber on the block.

credits.overview: After two years together and a lot of financial planning, Júlio and Daiana finally reach their dream of holding the long-awaited wedding party, so that they can finally get married in the church as per the rules. credits.title: Anita
credits.overview: The youth of Anita Garibaldi, portrayed in her humanity, with the simple life of an ordinary and very poor citizen. From a young age, the girl already showed courage. Over the years, she becomes a brave and libertarian warrior who overthrew paradigms of her time.

credits.title: Os Sonhos de um Sonhador - A História de Frank Aguiar
Urban Snap-Shots
credits.overview: Comedic portrait of middle-aged women in Rio de Janeiro, including overworked housewife Magali and her over-the-top twin sister Magda, psychoanalyst Paula and her troublesome daughter Melanie, and stage star in crisis Lise.

credits.title: The Hero
credits.overview: A 20-year veteran of the Angolan civil war returns to the capital city of Luanda where he faces the challenges of assimilation and survival.

credits.title: Favorite Son
credits.overview: Claudia Maccari, an Italian doctor who has a Brazilian adopted son suffering from leukemia, goes to Rio de Janeiro to find the child's biological mother for a transplant. She is reluctantly helped by a Detective.

credits.title: A Hidden Life
credits.overview: Biela, a humble young woman, born and raised in an isolated farm, is brought to a small town to live with her bourgeois cousins, her only relatives. Once in town, she encounters great difficulty adapting to city life.

credits.title: The Story of Fausta
credits.overview: An unhappily married cleaning woman in the slums of Rio entices all the money and gifts she can out of an elderly widower.

credits.title: Lerfá Mú
credits.overview: Strange graffiti on the walls of Rio de Janeiro, with the meaningless words Lerfá Mú, become the talk of the town, and cause for concern for the authorities.

credits.title: Paranóia
credits.overview: Four thieves enter a house and terrorize a family.

credits.title: Codfish
credits.overview: A terrible monster threatens the beach season: the cod from Guinea. To catch the fish, local authorities count on the expertise of a Portuguese oceanographer, a fearless fisherman, and baits made with Amália Rodrigues's records.

credits.title: King of the Night
credits.overview: In the 1940s, São Paulo nightlife is the setting for Tezinho's love affairs. In love with Aninha, he needs to get away from the girl and ends up getting involved with other women, including an obsessive relationship with a prostitute.

credits.title: Gente Que Transa
credits.overview: Competing for the concession of a TV channel, one of the contenders throws an orgy to defeat the other candidate.
